title: Private driver tour and shopping very nice
text: He was delightful and helpful and personable and accommodating very nice.  Fun day enjoyable.  We planned just shopping and a little sightseeing he was great
author: Debra_G

title: Jenny was the perfect...
text: Jenny was the perfect guide! She was very personable and knowledgeable. My friend and I already had a couple of pre-planned tours scheduled with Viking and Jenny crafted the perfect tour for us so there was duplication. We thoroughly enjoyed our time on our private tour. You can’t go wrong with Jenny.
author: Cathy_S

title: Expert driver and guide.
text: Roman the driver and Jenny the guide were excellent! I have a mobility issue and they were very helpful and accommodating! Roman was an expert driver. Driving around the city. Jenny was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable! We highly recommend them!
author: Rita_N

title: 5/5 Stars – Highly Accommodating & Seamless Private Driver in Barcelona!
text:
We booked a 4-hour private driver experience in Barcelona, and it proved to be an incredibly efficient way to cover major ground in comfort. Our driver arrived right on time directly in front of our hotel and handled the city traffic seamlessly all day.

Though guides were unfortunately fully booked for our specific date and time, our driver was more than accommodating when we decided to customize our itinerary on the fly. title: Truly the best of Barcelona!
text: Albert is a terrific guide! He took us all around Barcelona and passed on a wealth of knowledge. We learned so much about this beautiful city today as well as its vibrant history. We hit all the highlights. This was our first visit and we will leave feeling we have missed nothing!
author: Diana_C

title: Jenny was exceptional,...
text: Jenny was exceptional, taking care of everything, then some. We had a very enjoyable and relaxing trip. Sheri (?) the driver was also excellent.
author: Kenny_W

title: This was an amazing tour...
text: This was an amazing tour of the Highlights of Barcelona (excluding Sagrada Família which we did separately).  Our tour guide Jenny was excellent and managed to share her commentary between 2 vans. They were also very flexible in terms of timing and pickup. Made our Barcelona trip even more special.
author: France_B

title: Barcelona experience
text: Albert was very knowledgeable, professional and thorough in his tour.   He gave unique and informative insight to local life in Barcelona.  Would highly recommend him to anyone.
